items.a: We use the official Google OAuth with a reviews-read-only permission. Your password never passes through us, and you can revoke the permission anytime from your Google account.

items.q: How well does the AI write in Greek?
items.a: Replies are written in the language of each review with natural phrasing — not translations. You approve every text before it's published, and you can always edit it.
On infrastructure inside the European Union, encrypted in transit and at rest. We are GDPR-compliant and you can request a full export or deletion at any time.

items.q: What does the free trial include?
items.a: Everything in the Growth plan for 14 days, without a card. At the end you choose whether to stay — if you do nothing, you are charged nothing.
Yes, in one click from settings — no phone call, no email. Your data stays exportable for 30 days after cancellation.
You do. Replies are published to your business's Google profile and remain there even if you leave Atterna.
